principles.source_definition: maintains a lower-abdominal tension ≥ 0.6 that is coupled to the tension (stiffness) of every segment; tonic, slow clock; costs energy
principles.walker2d_operationalization: tonic module proposing joint torques from torso height deviation and joint angles (lower-body stiffness)
principles.ignition: learned sigmoid gate with a tonic bias term (may stay on)
principles.organization_metric: mean (torso height − initial height)² over surviving steps
principles.transfer_note: changes operationalization: 'tension' becomes torque-level stiffness; there is no abdominal state in Walker2d

principles.source_definition: ignites when |body axis| > 0.02; adds a lean correction proportional to the axis to every segment; costs energy
principles.walker2d_operationalization: module proposing joint torques from torso pitch and pitch rate
principles.ignition: learned sigmoid gate on |torso pitch| and |pitch rate|
principles.organization_metric: mean torso pitch² over surviving steps (lower = better axis maintenance)
principles.transfer_note: changes operationalization: the 5-segment lean stack becomes a single torso pitch plus hip/knee/ankle joints

principles.source_definition: ignites when an external push is registered; damps the push and reduces lean
principles.walker2d_operationalization: module proposing damping torques from joint velocities
principles.ignition: learned sigmoid gate on the magnitude of joint and torso angular velocities (disturbance proxy)
principles.organization_metric: mean squared action change ‖a_t − a_{t−1}‖² (jerk proxy)
principles.transfer_note: changes operationalization: 'push registered' becomes a velocity-magnitude proxy; no push sensor is given to any controller

principles.alias: upward abdominal organization / minimum-distance action (alias mapping uncertain)

xeno14.objective: round-robin: each module on survival − λ·(its organization metric)

multiobjective-scalarized-mlp.objective: survival − λ·mean of the three normalized organization metrics

xeno14-scalarized-training.objective: all module parameters jointly on the scalarized objective

ops.sensor_arrangement: 17-dim proprioceptive observation (torso height/pitch, 6 joint angles, root and joint velocities)
ops.boundary: whole Walker2d body; push applied to the torso by the environment, not sensed directly
ops.resource_constraints: action bounds [−1, 1]; no energy budget in X14-1
